GET.why: The OAuth callback names no club record: it consumes a single-use state bound to an HttpOnly cookie and finds the link by (provider, subject), the approved system-scope lookup of D-027, which narrows to the linked user's tenant and organization. TEST-S01 covers it; without the provider round trip the probe engine can only reach the invalid-state redirect.

POST.why: Starts linking the caller's own account (the user is taken from the session); the request names only the provider, no record. It redirects to the provider, which the probe engine cannot follow. The seeded links are read back by the GET probes.

GET.why: Sessionless sign-in start (or the caller's own link): the request names only the provider and a same-origin landing path, no record, and answers a redirect to the provider, which the probe engine cannot follow.

PUT.why: Changes the caller's own login e-mail (the user is taken from the session) after checking the current password; the request names no record of any club. TEST-737 covers it.

POST.why: Moves the expiry of the caller's own session (the session id comes from the signed JWT); the request names no record of any club. TEST-737 covers it.
